Comment: The content pipeline's steps (Epic 146, Specs/ADR_Content_Pipeline.md). Each step's Script runs in the editor (run_in_editor.py) and owns its Outputs; an output ending in / is a folder the step owns whole. Its Inputs are the files it reads. Library counts as a source of every step. Paths are relative to the repo root; a directory stands for every file in it.

Steps.Description: The default level, /Game/Maps/GameMap: lit, with the match as its game mode. The field builds itself at runtime from data.
The world kit (RawAssets/world) imported through Interchange, after tools/assets/world/unreal.mjs makes it engine-ready (Specs/World_Kit_Import_Spec.md).
